Ontology FAQs: Five Questions I Always Get Asked

Released Dec 8, 2025, 11 min

Play Ontology FAQs: Five Questions I Always Get Asked on YouTube
Watch on YouTube

In this video, I go over five "elevator pitch" responses to FAQs. They are:

1. What are ontologies?

2. How can they help me?

3. Can't {tool x} do that, too?

4. How much does your ontology know?

5. When will the ontology be done?

All of these answers will be context-dependent. But the broad-strokes first pass is the same, until you can dive into specifics that will meet your questioner where they are.
